summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.49/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.49 a gallon across Wisconsin as of July 6, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 9¢ lower than a week ago, 43¢ lower than a month ago, and 63¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.36) and the highest in La Crosse ($3.64).
